verdict.rationale: Zero is an open-source, self-hostable AI email app. Subscribing to events such as new mail via webhooks is a fair question for an email product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only an MCP capability list (read, send, label emails) authenticated by a session cookie. It states there is no public HTTP API, and nothing describes registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The generic 'Developer-Friendly – built with extensibility and integrations in mind' claim is not evidence of webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
